paragraphs: Build agents. Build their ontologies. All locally.
AgentLab is a single-machine deployable agent-building platform built with Go (CloudWeGo Eino/ADK), React and SQLite. It is organized around two cores:
Everything runs locally: data lives in a local SQLite database, model API keys are AES-256-GCM encrypted on disk, and the only external dependency is the LLM provider(s) you configure.
features: Agent engineering — a conversational agent workbench with fully observable execution, multi-agent collaboration, and knowledge / skill / ontology augmentation.
Ontology engineering — a full ontology (knowledge-graph) lifecycle: build → asset management → runtime engines → consumption & audit.

Every step of execution is visible — on top of SSE streaming replies, tool calls, deep thinking, sub-agent delegation, knowledge recall and ontology queries appear as color-coded event cards; expandable JSON, raw-event…

Multi-agent collaboration — projects orchestrate multiple agents (Agent-as-Tool / Transfer) with a visible delegation timeline; a 2–4 pane comparison mode runs the same question under different configurations (model /…

Knowledge · skill · ontology augmentation — document upload → chunking → embedding → retrieval, with a GraphRAG sub-module covering graph browsing, multi-hop retrieval and community-summary QA; skill packs inject with…
